statements.subject: server
statements.description: The resource at this URI MUST return an AgentCard object as defined in Section 4.4.1 of the A2A specification.
actions: Return an AgentCard object as defined in Section 4.4.1 at the /.well-known/agent-card.json URI

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The Agent Card MAY contain public information about an agent's capabilities and SHOULD NOT include sensitive credentials or internal implementation details
actions: Include public information about an agent's capabilities in the Agent Card

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The Agent Card MAY contain public information about an agent's capabilities and SHOULD NOT include sensitive credentials or internal implementation details
actions: Exclude sensitive credentials from the Agent Card
Exclude internal implementation details from the Agent Card

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Implementations SHOULD support HTTPS to ensure authenticity and integrity of the Agent Card
actions: Support HTTPS for serving and retrieving the Agent Card to ensure authenticity and integrity

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Cards MAY be signed using JSON Web Signatures (JWS) as specified in the AgentCardSignature object (Section 4.4.7)
actions: Sign the Agent Card using JSON Web Signatures (JWS) as specified in the AgentCardSignature object

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD verify signatures when present to ensure the Agent Card has not been tampered with
actions: Verify the JWS signature on the Agent Card when a signature is present
Confirm the Agent Card has not been tampered with

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Extended Agent Cards retrieved via authenticated endpoints (Section 3.1.11) MAY contain additional information and MUST enforce appropriate access controls
actions: Include additional information in Extended Agent Cards beyond what is available in the public Agent Card

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Extended Agent Cards retrieved via authenticated endpoints (Section 3.1.11) MAY contain additional information and MUST enforce appropriate access controls
actions: Enforce appropriate access controls on endpoints serving Extended Agent Cards
